$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

notes.description: Why these values (design targets, references), for owner review.

safeHeight.description: Equivalent drop at or below which a landing does no damage, m.

lethalHeight.description: Equivalent drop that deals 100% of max health, m; damage rises linearly from safeHeight. Above safeHeight.

deepWater.description: Landing in liquid at least this deep takes no fall damage, m.

fall.description: Fall and wall-impact damage: a fraction of max health from the equivalent drop height. Soft ground (impactAbsorb) takes off its share.

minSpeed.description: Relative speed a physics object must exceed to hurt a creature it strikes, m/s.

joulesPerPoint.description: Blunt damage = ½·m·v² / joulesPerPoint (kinetic energy of the strike, J).

kinetic.description: Falling and thrown physics objects striking creatures.

when.description: The boolean world property that makes an entity this hazard (e.g. burning).

perSecond.description: Damage per second, per damage type, to a creature within reach.

reach.description: How far beyond the hazard entity’s bounding sphere it hurts, m.

pulseMs.description: Damage lands in pulses this far apart, whole ms (perSecond × pulse length each).

items.description: A hazard volume: anything with the property hurts creatures that overlap it.

hazards.description: Hazard volumes, by the property that makes them.
